sn35.17:1.1: no cedaṃ bhikkhave cakkhussa assādo abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā cakkhusmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.2: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi cakkhussa assādo tasmā sattā cakkhusmiṃ sārajjanti
sn35.17:1.3: no cedaṃ bhikkhave cakkhussa ādīnavo abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā cakkhusmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi cakkhussa ādīnavo tasmā sattā cakkhusmiṃ nibbindanti
sn35.17:1.5: no cedaṃ bhikkhave cakkhussa nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā cakkhusmā nissareyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi cakkhussa nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā cakkhusmā nissaranti.
sn35.17:1.7: no cedaṃ bhikkhave sotassa assādo abhavissa.
sn35.17:1.8: no cedaṃ bhikkhave ghānassa assādo abhavissa.
sn35.17:1.9: no cedaṃ bhikkhave jivhāya assādo abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā jivhāya sārajjeyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.10: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi jivhāya assādo tasmā sattā jivhāya sārajjanti
sn35.17:1.11: no cedaṃ bhikkhave jivhāya ādīnavo abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā jivhāya nibbindeyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.12: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi jivhāya nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā jivhāya nibbindanti
sn35.17:1.13: no cedaṃ bhikkhave jivhāya nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā jivhāya nissareyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.14: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi jivhāya nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā jivhāya nissaranti.
sn35.17:1.15: no cedaṃ bhikkhave kāyassa assādo abhavissa.
sn35.17:1.16: no cedaṃ bhikkhave manassa assādo abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā manasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.17: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi manassa assādo tasmā sattā manasmiṃ sārajjanti
sn35.17:1.18: no cedaṃ bhikkhave manassa ādīnavo abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā manasmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.19: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi manassa ādīnavo tasmā sattā manasmiṃ nibbindanti
sn35.17:1.20: no cedaṃ bhikkhave manassa nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa na yidaṃ sattā manasmā nissareyyuṃ
sn35.17:1.21: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi manassa nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā manasmā nissaranti.
sn35.17:2.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave sattā imesaṃ channaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsuṃ. neva tāva bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaññuttā vippamuttā vipariyādikatena cetasā vihariṃsu.
sn35.17:2.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave sattā imesaṃ channaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsuṃ. atha bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaññuttā vippamuttā vipariyādikatena cetasā viharantīti.
